fundamental.text: Raw sugar is 2.00¢/lb above hydrous-ethanol parity in Brazil, so mills favour sugar in the mix (more supply). Sugar in BRL at R$2,314/t (59th pct of 5 yrs). Raws are holding the 18c area by short covering rather than fresh buying: long liquidation keeps probing the floor, but funds have stopped adding to sales and producer hedging stays light with the real weak. Desk read: The Brazil-led slide held into the afternoon: the real weakened further to ~5.93 per dollar (about -2.7% on the day) and Mar raws traded ~17.15, near session lows. A cheaper real lifts mills' local-currency return on exports, so Centre-South export hedging is likely to keep pressing rallies while the currency is unstable.
